contract: Connect an existing claimed Moltbook account by named Gideon credential, enforcing the official https://www.moltbook.com/api/v1 bearer boundary. Guard profile, claim-status, feed and comment reads. Require explicit approval for post/comment writes, persist idempotent content-redacted receipts before dispatch, and keep published, pending_verification, failed and uncertain outcomes distinct. Account registration and automatic challenge solving are excluded; no live external mutation occurs during local qualification.
acceptance: A named credential configures an existing account without returning or persisting its secret in adapter state, receipts or UI; non-www production endpoints and credential-bearing URLs are refused.
Actual HTTP protocol-server reads use bearer auth and current profile/status/feed/comments endpoints with bounded queries and durable content-free history.

Post and comment writes do not dispatch without explicit approval; approved requests use current wire bodies, persist before dispatch, replay idempotently and distinguish pending verification, published, rate-limited failure and uncertain outcomes.

Owner API, console and native tools traverse the real adapter and HTTP protocol server. Native writes require approval; registration is absent. Live Moltbook account and outbound mutation proof remains pending separate authorization and credentials.

qualification.external_proof: pending: no account credential supplied and no live outbound posts/comments authorized
limitations: Shared experience route registration, page mounting and moltbook.sqlite3 durability enrollment remain root integration hooks.
